other_conditions: The applicant must be a New or Existing IT unit operating in Goa
The unit must be one of the following legal entities: Proprietorship Firm, Private Limited Company, Public Limited Company, Registered Partnership Firm, or Limited Liability Partnership
Bank accounts of the unit and/or its partner(s)/director(s) must be linked to Aadhaar
Only expenses incurred after the notification of the policy are eligible for the subsidy
The unit should be operational for at least one year before applying for the incentive
Employees must be on the rolls of the company for a minimum period of one year to qualify for the rebate
Units will be subject to evaluation at the end of the fiscal year or each installment period to verify continued eligibility
benefits_summary: Provides lease rental reimbursement up to 50% (60% where ≥30% of employees are women) of annual lease rentals for up to two years, with additional incentives based on employee composition and caps for smaller business units.
